hooks.name: claims-guard
hooks.description: When a prompt is about user-facing words, remind the agent of the banned claims and the intended-purpose sentence. The matcher keeps it off for other prompts, so it only costs credits when relevant.

action.prompt: If this request adds or changes user-facing words (UI, README, website, Devpost, video script, posts), check them against the banned claims in .kiro/steering/product.md and the words in .kiro/steering/trademarks.md before you write. Keep the intended-purpose sentence verbatim where it appears. Use only numbers from packages/eval/RESULTS.md, with the method linked. If nothing user-facing changes, ignore this note.
